## Summary
2020 trade-press confirmation that the Infigo↔printIQ partnership formalized at PrintEx Sydney in August 2019 was being expanded. Useful for dating when the Connect: printIQ deep integration actually started — and confirming the relationship now has multi-year history (~6 years and ~50 mutual customers as of 2025).

## Key takeaways
- **Timeline anchor:** Partnership formalized at PrintEx Sydney, August 2019. The 2020 announcement was the *extension* of that partnership — adding dedicated features beyond the initial scope.
- **Douglas Gibson quote (MD, Infigo at the time, now CEO):** describes printIQ as not "one size fits all" — "constantly releasing exciting new features … based on individual feedback from their clients. Which is exactly how we operate at Infigo." Reads as mutual culture validation.
- **Sales pitch:** "seamless, end-to-end estimating, ordering, and production workflow system" — this is the language our shop should recognize from current Connect: printIQ docs.
- **Comment thread:** Juliana Nayee (Infigo) posted the webinar registration link in the comments — minor but confirms Infigo's marketing presence on Whitmar trade outlets.
